title: Bass
description: Plays a bass line on the notes it receives, using the sounds of a sample set (the default is analog-808) and a bass pattern. It needs notes as input and gives audio.

parameters.name: set
parameters.doc: The built-in bass, or a sample folder of the project with note-named WAV files.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.doc: The built-in bass has one pattern for now.

parameters.name: gain
parameters.doc: Level of a sampled bass. It applies to the built-in sound too.

parameters.name: humanize
parameters.doc: A little human feel: at 100 every note starts up to 6 ms early or late and up to 15 % louder or softer (deterministic from the seed). 0 plays exactly on the grid. Works for a sampled instrument and for the built-in sound.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

needs: A sample set folder for the bass sounds (parameter set, default analog-808).
